title: Optimizing R Scripts for Machine Learning: Building a Classification Template

cues.en: Instructor: Hello my friends.
cues.zh: 大家好。

cues.en: Congratulations again for having implemented your first classification model, logistic aggression.
cues.zh: 再次恭喜完成第一個分類模型，邏輯斯迴歸。

cues.en: And now, before we move on to the next model, I would like to make a classification template that will allow us to build much more efficiently the next classification models of this part.
cues.zh: 進下一個模型前，先建立分類模板，讓本部分其他模型能更有效率地建立。

cues.en: And not only that, it is a template that you will also be able to use for your personal data set.
cues.zh: 也能用於自己的資料集。

cues.en: All right.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: So let's do this.
cues.zh: 開始吧。

cues.en: At the top of our studio, we're gonna click file, and then click new file, and then R script, all right?
cues.zh: 在 RStudio 頂部點 File、New File，再選 R Script。

cues.en: And we're gonna save this as classification template, all right?
cues.zh: 儲存為 Classification Template。

cues.en: Then we click save.
cues.zh: 點 Save。

cues.en: And you will see it appear in your file here.
cues.zh: 就會出現在檔案清單。

cues.en: That's the new R file we just created.
cues.zh: 這是剛建立的新 R 檔。

cues.en: All right.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: Then, we're gonna take our logistic progression implementation.
cues.zh: 取用邏輯斯迴歸實作。

cues.en: Again, we're gonna select everything, copy it, and then paste it in our classification template.
cues.zh: 再次全選、複製，貼到分類模板。

cues.en: And then let's change the title.
cues.zh: 接著改標題。

cues.en: We're gonna replace this by classification template.
cues.zh: 換成 Classification Template。

cues.en: And then in the data pre pressing sections here, we're gonna keep everything as is, except one thing.
cues.zh: 前處理部分幾乎全部保留，只改一件事。

cues.en: We're gonna add one line of code that will make sure the classes of our dependent variable are indeed classes.
cues.zh: 加一行程式，確保應變數的類別確實是類別，

cues.en: And you know, not continuous numbers.
cues.zh: 而不是連續數值。

cues.en: So for most of the models like logistic regression, KNN, Nave based, SVM, and Kernel SVM, the package that we'll use to build those models will recognize
cues.zh: 對邏輯斯迴歸、KNN、樸素貝氏、SVM 與 Kernel SVM，多數套件會辨認

cues.en: the classes of our datasets as classes.
cues.zh: 資料集裡的類別。

cues.en: But there will be two models that we'll build which are decision tree and random forest that will not recognize them as classes.
cues.zh: 但決策樹與隨機森林這兩個模型，不一定自動辨認。

cues.en: And therefore, to make this template applicable to all the models we're gonna build in this part three, we just need to add this little code section here that I'm gonna call,
cues.zh: 為了讓模板適用第三部分所有模型，加入這一小段，命名為

cues.en: "encoding the target feature as factor".
cues.zh: Encoding the Target Feature as Factor。

cues.en: And that will make sure that the purchased dependent variable of our dataset will be encoded as factors.
cues.zh: 確保 Purchased 應變數被編碼為因子。

cues.en: And to do so, we use the factor function inside, which we enter first the dependent variable column, which we access from our data set then adding a dollar again,
cues.zh: 使用 factor，第一個引數是應變數欄位，從 dataset 加美元符號，

cues.en: and then there we go, purchased.
cues.zh: 再加 Purchased。

cues.en: So that's the first argument of this factor function.
cues.zh: 這是 factor 第一個引數。

cues.en: And then we just need to specify the two classes here with this argument levels that will be equal to our two classes zero and one, which we have to enter in this C function,
cues.zh: 然後用 levels 指定兩個類別 0、1，放入 c 函數，

cues.en: which will take as input zero and one.
cues.zh: c 接收 0 與 1。

cues.en: All right, so let me recap this.
cues.zh: 總結一下。

cues.en: This line of code is optional for the logistic regression model, the K-nearest neighbor model which we'll implement next.
cues.zh: 對邏輯斯迴歸與接下來的 K 最近鄰模型，這行是選用。

cues.en: Then the SVM model, the Kernel SVM model, and the Nave based model.
cues.zh: SVM、Kernel SVM 與樸素貝氏也一樣。

cues.en: And it is compulsory for the decision tree classification model and for the random four classification model.
cues.zh: 對決策樹分類與隨機森林分類，則是必要。

cues.en: All right?
cues.zh: 好嗎？

cues.en: So I just wanna include it here so that we can apply this template to all the classification models of this part three.
cues.zh: 我將它放進模板，才能適用第三部分全部分類模型。

cues.en: And for that, let's make the other required changes.
cues.zh: 接著做其他必要修改。

cues.en: So here, when splitting the data sets into the training set and the test sets, we don't have to change anything.
cues.zh: 分割訓練集與測試集的部分，不用修改。

cues.en: Same, we can keep feature scaling and then that's where we will change some things.
cues.zh: 特徵縮放也保留，然後這裡要改一些內容。

cues.en: But first we will remove all this because that's where we'll build our next classifier.
cues.zh: 先移除這些，因為下一個分類器會在這裡建立。

cues.en: And so we can add a comment saying, "create your classifier here."
cues.zh: 加註解「在這裡建立分類器」。

cues.en: Okay.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: Then we can replace logistic aggression here by classifier.
cues.zh: 再把 Logistic Regression 換成 Classifier。

cues.en: Alright, to make it generic.
cues.zh: 讓模板通用。

cues.en: Then here, very important.
cues.zh: 接著這裡很重要。

cues.en: The logistic aggression model is the only model of this part three that returns first its predictions in the form of probabilities.
cues.zh: 邏輯斯迴歸是第三部分唯一先以機率形式傳回預測的模型。

cues.en: All the other models will return directly zero or one and therefore we're gonna remove this line.
cues.zh: 其他模型直接傳回 0 或 1，所以刪掉這行。

cues.en: We're gonna replace here prob pred by y pred.
cues.zh: 將 prob_pred 換成 y_pred。

cues.en: And and here in the predict function, we're gonna keep classifier of course, we're gonna remove type equals response, and we're gonna keep new data equals test set minus three, all right?
cues.zh: predict 裡保留 classifier，移除 type='response'，並保留 newdata=test_set[,-3]。

cues.en: And this line of code will be applicable to all the remaining classification models of part three.
cues.zh: 這行適用第三部分其餘所有分類模型。

cues.en: We won't have to change anything here, okay?
cues.zh: 不必再改。

cues.en: And then same for the confusion matrix.
cues.zh: 混淆矩陣也相同。

cues.en: This is only for the logistic regression model because it returns probabilities.
cues.zh: 這個機率處理只用於邏輯斯迴歸。

cues.en: And so to adapt this to a model that returns only zero one we'll of course going to remove larger than 0.5, right?
cues.zh: 要適應直接傳回 0、1 的模型，當然移除大於 0.5 的條件。

cues.en: Because the widespread of our future classification models will only contain zero one exactly as the dependent variable column of the test set.
cues.zh: 因為之後的 y_pred，和測試集應變數一樣，只包含 0、1。

cues.en: Okay, great.
cues.zh: 很好。

cues.en: And then finally in the last two sections here, visualizing the training set and test results.
cues.zh: 最後兩段，視覺化訓練與測試結果。

cues.en: Same, we're gonna remove the probabilities here then cut this y grid and then replace this prop set variable by y grid
cues.zh: 同樣移除機率處理，剪下 y_grid，取代 prob_set 變數，

cues.en: and then remove the type equals response parameter so that now we don't have a predictions returned in the form of probabilities, but zeros and ones.
cues.zh: 並移除 type='response'，讓預測不再是機率，而是 0、1。

cues.en: And then of course, we're gonna make it generate again by replacing logistic aggression here by class five.
cues.zh: 再將 Logistic Regression 換成 Classifier，維持通用。

cues.en: Okay. Excellent.
cues.zh: 很好。

cues.en: So now let's copy this because we're gonna do the same down there for the visualization of the test set results.
cues.zh: 複製這段，下面測試集也做相同修改。

cues.en: So I'm gonna replace these two lines by what we just copied.
cues.zh: 用剛才複製的內容，取代這兩行。

cues.en: There we go.
cues.zh: 完成。

cues.en: And then replace logistic progression again by classifier.
cues.zh: 再把 Logistic Regression 換成 Classifier。

cues.en: And now congratulations.
cues.zh: 恭喜。

cues.en: We have a generic template that we will be able to use to build very efficiently our next classification models of 0.3.
cues.zh: 現在有通用模板，可以很有效率地建立第三部分後續模型。

cues.en: So let's save this and now look forward to building those next models with you.
cues.zh: 儲存，期待一起建立下一個模型。

cues.en: And until then, enjoy machine learning!
cues.zh: 在此之前，享受機器學習吧。
